dom.scene: An empty wooden dance studio after sunset. She practices one solo waltz turn, with one foot stepping and the other grounded, arms held in a relaxed open dance frame below shoulder height. She glances toward the camera with an amused smile. Warm pendant lights, dark rainy windows, mirrors outside the image so no reflected duplicate figure, hands clearly separated.
dom.outfit: An emerald sleeveless wrap midi dress with a diagonal neckline, fitted waist, high side slit and fluid opaque skirt, low dance heels, tiny navy spiral bracelet. Bare shoulders, arms and one leg, elegant personal dance practice clothing; no armor or stage costume.
